title: RegulaTutor: A Theory-Informed Framework for Long-Term Personalized Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term personalized tutoring requires language models to translate a learner's evolving history into appropriate instructional support. Existing LLM-based tutoring systems use memory and retrieval to personalize responses, but the pedagogical rationale linking historical evidence to teaching strategies is not always explicit. We introduce RegulaTutor, a theory-informed framework for long-term personalized tutoring that connects historical evidence, learner interpretation, and learner-facing instruction. Guided by self-regulated learning (SRL) research, its tutoring harness operationalizes a cognitive, affective, metacognitive, and motivational (CAMM) framework for deriving evidence-supported learner interpretations and teaching policies. The resulting policies retain links to their supporting evidence and are updated as new observations arrive. This staged workflow also supports systematic refinement through PairRoute, an offline proc

translated_title: RegulaTutor：一个基于理论的长程个性化学习框架
translated_abstract: 长期个性化辅导要求语言模型能够将学习者不断演进的历史记录转化为适当的教学支持。现有基于大语言模型的辅导系统使用记忆和检索技术来个性化响应，但将历史证据与教学策略联系起来的教学理论依据并不总是明确的。我们提出了RegulaTutor，这是一个面向长期个性化辅导的基于理论的框架，它将历史证据、学习者解读和面向学习者的教学三者连接起来。在自我调节学习（SRL）研究的指导下，其辅导框架实现了一个涵盖认知、情感、元认知和动机（CAMM）的框架，用于推导有证据支持的学习者解读和教学策略。所得策略保留与其支持证据的联系，并随着新观察结果的到来而持续更新。这一分阶段的工作流程还通过PairRoute支持系统性改进，PairRoute是一种离线处理……
tldr: 提出基于自我调节学习理论的RegulaTutor框架，通过CAMM（认知、情感、元认知、动机）机制将学习者历史证据转化为有据可依的教学策略并随新观察持续更新，实现长程个性化辅导。
en_tdlr: RegulaTutor is a theory-informed framework grounded in self-regulated learning research that operationalizes a CAMM (cognitive, affective, metacognitive, motivational) framework to derive evidence-supported learner interpretations and teaching policies, enabling long-term personalized tutoring with policies that stay linked to their supporting evidence.
